smart-hospital-system.title: Smart Hospital System
smart-hospital-system.summary: An AI-powered medical chatbot designed to streamline preliminary patient assessments, identify missing medical information, and reduce pressure on healthcare professionals in crowded hospitals.
smart-hospital-system.summaryAr: روبوت محادثة ذكي يقوم بالتشخيص المبدئي للمرضى
smart-hospital-system.overview: Smart Hospital System is a microservices-based healthcare solution that enables patients to receive preliminary medical assessments before consulting a doctor. It uses an intelligent chatbot to collect patient information, analyze symptoms, and integrate specialized AI models capable of processing medical data and images across multiple clinical specialties.
smart-hospital-system.problem: Hospitals and clinics often face overcrowding and excessive workloads. Patients may arrive without necessary medical information, laboratory tests, or imaging results, leading to inefficient consultations, repeated visits, and additional pressure on doctors.
smart-hospital-system.solution:
The system acts as an intelligent first point of contact. It interacts with patients, identifies missing information or potentially required medical tests, and uses specialized AI models to generate concise preliminary reports, including predicted conditions and confidence scores where supported.

This helps prepare patients for medical consultations and aims to reduce unnecessary delays and clinical workloads.
smart-hospital-system.role: Backend Developer & AI Integration Engineer - Developed the core backend using Node.js to manage chatbot conversations and application logic. - Implemented AI tool calling to dynamically invoke specialized medical analysis services. - Built Python API services to expose previously trained AI models. - Integrated Python-based inference services with the Node.js backend through RESTful APIs. - Designed communication and data exchange between backend services in a microservices architecture.
features: AI Medical Chatbot: Interactive preliminary patient assessment.
Multi-Specialty Support: Integration with AI models for different medical conditions.
Medical Image Analysis: Processing supported MRI and other medical imaging inputs.
Missing Information Detection: Identifies additional information or tests potentially needed before consultation.
Preliminary Medical Reports: Generates concise assessment results with model confidence estimates where available.
AI Tool Calling: Dynamically selects and invokes relevant analysis services.
Microservices Architecture: Node.js orchestration with independent Python inference services.
